history.summary: The algo's 'cheap' (-2.9%) and high 8.59% CAGR are data quirks from a tiny 36-unit freehold micro-development with thin transactions (17 appreciation txns, 3-txn cohort). Verified comps show the asking PSF is actually ABOVE the recent average, and the micro-project poses real liquidity risk.
history.rating_rationale: Asking 1,693.74 PSF vs verified 12-month resale range 1,467-1,727 (avg ~1,594) — the ask is ~6% ABOVE the trailing average and near the top of the range, so the -2.9% age-adj 'cheap' label is wrong; this is priced rich, not at a discount. The 8.59% CAGR rests on only 17 transactions with a 3-txn size-cohort — exactly the small-sample data quirk v3.4 warns against, not a real bargain. Presto is a 36-unit freehold block with minimal facilities; freehold is NOT a forward edge per the backtest, and the micro-scale means weak resale liquidity and depth. Serangoon MRT/NEX is a 10-min walk (good but not at-door). Net: paying a premium to recent comps for an illiquid asset on noisy signals.
red_flags: Asking PSF (1,693.74) is ~6% ABOVE the verified 12-month average (~1,594) and near the top of the range — not cheap
8.59% CAGR built on only 17 txns; psf_cohort_txns of 3 — high noise, likely a data quirk
36-unit micro-development with minimal facilities — thin resale liquidity and limited buyer pool
Freehold tenure is not a forward edge (v3.4); it does not offset the rich pricing
catalysts: 10-min walk to Serangoon MRT interchange (NEL/CCL) and NEX mall
D19/OCR region (the only genuine positive, but undermined by rich entry pricing)
